t: This is St Stephen's Church in Lewisham. It was designed by Sir George Gilbert Scott, one of the most prolific English architects of the Gothic Revival. He is chiefly known for designing and renovating churches and cathedrals, though he began his career designing workhouses. Over eight hundred buildings were designed or altered by him, so a church here is part of a very large body of work. Look at the stonework and the pointed Gothic details that mark his style.
